welcome:
Welcome to the Docker CLI Playground.
Simulated production host running web app + postgres + redis + nginx.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: List all running containers to see the current state.
The web app is missing. Check all containers including stopped ones.
The web container exited with code 1. Check its logs.
Connection refused to postgres. Inspect the webapp to check its environment variables.
DB_HOST is wrong — says 'localhost' instead of 'postgres'. Check the network to see if containers can reach each other.
Inspect app-network to see which containers are connected.
Postgres is on app-network but webapp is on bridge. Remove the bad container.
Re-run the webapp with the correct DB_HOST and network.
steps.expect: docker run -d --name webapp --network app-network -e DB_HOST=postgres -p 8080:8080 myregistry/webapp:v1.5.0
steps.hint: Try: docker run -d --name webapp --network app-network -e DB_HOST=postgres -p 8080:8080 myregistry/webapp:v1.5.0

scenarios.title: Build, Ship, and Deploy with Compose

steps.instruction: Check the existing images on this host.
Build the webapp image from the Dockerfile.
Verify the new image was created.
Check the image layers and size breakdown.
Bring up the full stack with docker compose.
Check the status of all compose services.
Check the live resource usage of all containers.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  docker ps                  — List running containers
  docker ps -a               — List all containers (including stopped)
  docker images              — List images
  docker run                 — Create and start a container
  docker build               — Build an image from Dockerfile
  docker logs                — View container logs
  docker inspect             — Detailed container/image info
  docker exec                — Execute command in running container
  docker stop/start/restart  — Container lifecycle
  docker rm / docker rmi     — Remove containers / images
  docker compose             — Multi-container orchestration
  docker network             — Manage networks
  docker volume              — Manage volumes
  docker system              — System-wide commands
  docker stats               — Live resource usage
  docker top                 — Running processes in container
  docker cp                  — Copy files to/from container
  docker tag                 — Tag an image
  docker push/pull           — Push/pull images
  docker history             — Show image layer history

  scenario                   — Start a guided lab
  clear                      — Clear the terminal
  help                       — Show this help

commands.docker compose config:
name: webapp
services:
  nginx:
    image: nginx:1.25-alpine
    ports:
      - 443:443
    depends_on:
      - api
    networks:
      - app-network
  api:
    build: ./api
    image: myregistry/api:v2.1.0
    ports:
      - 8080:8080
    environment:
      DB_HOST: postgres
      REDIS_HOST: redis-cache
    depends_on:
      - db
      - redis
    networks:
      - app-network
  db:
    image: postgres:15.6-alpine
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: production
    networks:
      - app-network
  redis:
    image: redis:7.2-alpine
    networks:
      - app-network
volumes:
  pgdata:
networks:
  app-network:
